2. Press "End employment" ("End engagement" for an external
   worker).
3. Pick the "Last day": today or earlier, and not before they started. A
   leaving date on their profile is suggested.
4. Read what will change and confirm.

Ending, all at once:

- removes them from every group of the organization and from approver slots;
- cancels their pending requests and their upcoming bookings; past bookings stay;
- ends their org admin access and their HR or Leadership role;
- clears "Reports to" on everyone who reported to them;
- removes the sections whose retention is set to end with the employment.

The owner, HR and organization administrators can end an employment by default. The owner's own
employment can't be ended, and someone who manages a group needs another manager for it first. No
plan is needed.

## People who left

The "Former" tab lists ended spells, most recent first, for the owner, organization
administrators and HR. Their profiles stay readable to them, and what is kept is governed by the
organization's retention periods.

## When someone comes back

A person who rejoins starts a new spell with an empty profile, marked
"Rejoined" for the owner, organization administrators and HR. The earlier
spell stays in "Former".

On the new profile, a banner offers "Copy from previous spell". It copies Contact,
Personal and the Profile photo from the previous spell, as far as retention kept them. Card, Work
contact and Job never carry over, and a section the new spell already holds is never overwritten.
The owner, organization administrators and HR can copy.

articles.title: Export the report to Excel
articles.summary: How to download the leave report as an Excel workbook, what its two sheets hold, and what to do when the file is too large.
headings: "That is too much data for one file. Narrow the filters and try again."
articles.body:
The Report page can download its data as an Excel workbook (`.xlsx`). Anyone who can open
the report can export it, and the file holds exactly what the report shows you.

## Download the workbook

1. Open Report and set the filters you want.
2. Press "Export to Excel". The dialog starts from the report's current filters.
3. Pick the year, groups, members and leave types, or leave them on "all".
4. Press "Download".

The export always covers one calendar year, even when the report shows the last 12 months.

## What the workbook holds

**Summary sheet**, one line per member, group and leave type with an allowance: carried over from
the previous year, the quota for the whole year, used to date, planned until the end of the year,
pending approval and remaining. The figures match the Members table on the
page.

**Detail sheet**, one line per booking: name, group, type, days, from and to, the day range,
year, month, status and note.

Both sheets have a frozen header row and Excel's filter switched on for every column, so you can
sort and filter straight away. Column headers and leave type names are in English whatever language
you use the app in.

## What stays out

- Public holidays never appear: a company-wide day off isn't leave anyone took.
- Someone else's Sick leave and rejected requests appear only if you approve or administer that
  person's group, or administer the organization. The same goes for the Note on their bookings,
  which is blank for everyone else.
- Your own rows are always complete.

Each export is recorded with who ran it, the year and the filters.

## "That is too much data for one file. Narrow the filters and try again."

One workbook holds at most 50,000 bookings. Narrow the filters (fewer groups, members or leave
types) and export in parts.

articles.title: External workers
articles.summary: What changes for a person marked as an external worker (no clocking, no allowances, a smaller profile) and how to change someone's worker type.
headings: What is different for an external worker
Adding someone as an external worker
articles.body:
Everyone in the [people directory](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/people-directory/) is either an employee or an external
worker: someone who works for the organization occasionally, on specific tasks. The profile and the
directory list mark external workers "External worker" for everyone who sees
them.

## What is different for an external worker

- **Attendance:** they can't clock in, owe no required time and don't appear on
  Team attendance. Their earlier history stays readable.
- **Allowances:** their Vacation,
  Home Office and Sick day
  allowances are zero, and nothing carries over at the turn of the year. They can book only leave
  types that draw on no allowance.
- **Profile:** contract type, working time, probation end and the whole Personal section don't
  apply.
- **What they see:** under the default Permission table, external workers read colleagues' Card and
  Photo only, not their work contact.

Groups, calendars, reports, notifications and birthdays work as for employees.

## Change someone's worker type

1. Open the person's profile under Directory.
2. Press "Change worker type".
3. Read what changes and confirm.

The owner, HR and organization administrators can do this by default. It needs the directory to be
on but no particular plan, and works only for someone still employed.

**Employee to external worker** clears, at once, the contract type, working time, probation end
date, the whole Personal section and any own required time. Their allowances in the organization's
groups go to zero from this year on. A session they had running can still be closed.

**External worker to employee** restores nothing. The cleared fields start empty and the allowances
stay at zero until a group admin sets them again; see [Allowances](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/allowances/).

## Adding someone as an external worker

When you add a person without an account, pick "External worker" as their worker
type. See [Add people and send directory invites](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/directory-invites/).

articles.title: Add a group event to the team calendar
articles.summary: Put a meeting, an offsite or a recurring team day on a group's calendar, and change or delete one date, the rest or all of it.
articles.body:
A group event is a date on a group's calendar that isn't anyone's time off: a team meeting, an
offsite, a release day. Everyone in the group sees it on the Dashboard calendar and in the
iPhone app.

## Who can add one

Any member of the group can add a group event, including members without the
View permission, and so can the group's admins. The group's organization must be on a paid plan: Pro, Enterprise or a
custom plan, the grace period included. Where none of your groups can take one, the button and menu
items for it don't appear.

## Add a group event

1. Press "+ New" in the top bar and choose
   "Group event". On the Dashboard you can also right-click a day and
   choose "New group event", or pick a day and use the button under it.
2. Fill in "Title", up to 100 characters, and pick the
   "Group".
3. Set the date. A one-off event can run over several days with "From" and
   "Until".
4. Leave "All day" on, or turn it off and set
   "Starts" and "Ends".
5. Add a "Note" if you like, up to 1,000 characters.
6. Press "Create".

## Make it repeat

Under "Repeat", pick "Daily",
"Weekly", "Monthly" or
"Yearly", and how often: every 1 to 99 days, weeks, months or years.

- **Weekly** repeats on the weekdays you tick. The start date's weekday is always one of them.
- **Monthly** repeats on the same day of the month, or on the same weekday such as the 2nd Tuesday
  or the last Friday. A day a month lacks falls on its last day.
- **Ends**: "Never" or "On a date".

"Next dates" previews the next six dates. A recurring event lasts one day,
so it can't also run over several days.

## Change or delete an event

Pick the day on the calendar to see its group events as cards, each with
"Edit" and "Delete". On a computer you can also
right-click the day.

Only the person who added the event, while still in the group, and the group's admins can change or
delete it. For everyone else, the card says who can.

For a recurring event, Flexi Day asks which dates the change applies to:

- **"This event"**: only the date you picked. The card then reads
  "Changed for this date only".
- **"This and following"**: that date and every later one. Earlier dates stay.
- **"All events"**: every date, past ones included.

Changing the repeat rule or the start for all dates drops the changes made to single dates. Flexi Day
counts them and warns you first.

Deleting can't be undone. The event leaves every calendar, including calendar feeds and synced
Google or Microsoft calendars.

## When the plan ends

On a group whose paid plan has lapsed, the existing events stay on the calendar and can still be
edited and deleted. New events can't be added, and neither can an edit that starts a new run of dates
or makes a one-off repeat. See [When a paid plan ends](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/lapsed-plan/).

## Where else they show

- Calendar feeds and direct sync can carry group events. See
  [Subscribe to time off in your calendar app](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/calendar-feed/) and
  [Sync your days off into Google or Microsoft calendar](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/calendar-direct-sync/).
- Adding, changing or deleting a group event sends no email or notification.

articles.title: Group permissions, the manager and removing members
articles.summary: What View, Admin, Approver and Tracked allow, how to change them, who the manager is, and what removing a member does.
articles.body:
Each member of a group holds four permissions, shown as columns on the group's
Members tab.

## The four permissions

| Permission                          | What it allows                                                                                                                        |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| View     | See everyone's time off in the group. Without it, a member sees only their own.                                                       |
| Admin    | Manage members and permissions, quotas, invites, settings and mirroring, and book leave for members. Includes View. Approves nothing. |
| Approver | Approve or reject members' leave requests. Manages nothing.                                                                           |
| Tracked  | Book leave in the group. Turn it off for someone who only oversees the group.                                                         |

Someone who joins through an invite starts with View and Tracked on, Admin and Approver off.

## Change permissions

1. Open the group from Groups and stay on Members.
2. Press "Edit permissions" and switch the values.
3. Save.

Group admins, the manager and organization administrators can do this. Nobody can raise their own
permissions, and an organization administrator can't make themselves an approver.

## The manager

Every group has one manager, marked on the Members tab. The manager always
administers the group and approves its requests, whatever their Admin and Approver values show. The
person who created the group starts as its manager.

To hand the group to someone else, the owner or an organization administrator presses
"Change manager" on the group page and picks a member. The manager and
group admins can't do this themselves. Permissions and approvers stay as they are.

## Remove a member

On the Members tab, press "Remove" next to the
person. They lose access to the group, and:

- their pending requests in the group are cancelled;
- their approved bookings there from tomorrow on are cancelled;
- past bookings and today's stay, with their history.

Nobody is notified. The manager can't be removed; give the group another manager first. If this
group was the person's last link to the organization, their employment there ends too, unless the
organization uses the people directory.

articles.title: Set a group's working days and public holidays
articles.summary: Choose which weekdays a group books leave on and which country's public holidays it skips.
articles.body:
The group's Settings tab holds two settings that decide which days a request
books. Group admins, the manager and organization administrators see this tab.

## Working days

Under "Working days", tick the weekdays the group works and press
"Save working days". At least one day is needed.

Requests book only these days. When someone requests a range, the other days in it are skipped, so
a Friday-to-Monday request in a Monday-to-Friday group books two days and counts two against the
allowance. A range with no working day in it is refused.

Working days belong to the group, so everyone in it shares them. They apply to new requests;
existing bookings stay as they are.

## Public holidays

Under "Public holidays", pick the "Country" and
press "Save public holidays". "None (no public holidays shown)" turns them
off.

The country's public holidays then:

- show on the Dashboard calendar for everyone in the group;
- are skipped when someone requests a range, like non-working days, so they cost no allowance.

They are never exported to calendar feeds.

## Where else these settings matter

Attendance has its own working days and holiday country, set for the whole organization on the
Organization page. The group's settings don't change attendance.

articles.title: Book half a day or add times
articles.summary: Book a half day that counts as 0.5, add start and end times, and add a note to a request.
articles.body:
A request can cover part of a day. Tick "Half day" to book half a day, and add
times if your team wants to know when you are out.

## Half a day

1. Open the request form and pick the same day in "From" and
   "To".
2. Tick "Half day". The box appears only when the request is a single day.
3. Submit as usual.

A half day counts as 0.5 days against the allowance of types that have one. It shows on the calendar
with a "½ day" mark. The form doesn't ask whether it is the morning or the
afternoon; add times or a note to say so.

To book half days on several dates, send one request for each date.

## Start and end times

"Start time (optional)" and "End time (optional)" are optional. They tell colleagues and
approvers when you are out, for example for a doctor's appointment, and show on the
Requests page in the "Time" column. Times don't change how much
the request counts: a full day counts 1, a half day 0.5, whatever the times say.

On a range of several days, the times apply to every day of it.

## The note

"Note (optional)" is free text for your approver, such as "Family trip". It is required for
the Other type. Only you, the group's approvers and its admins see
the note; teammates don't. See [Who sees your time off](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/who-sees-your-time-off/).

## Changing it later

You can't change a half day or times on a request you sent; cancel it and book again. A group admin
can change the type, half day, times and note of an existing request. See
[Cancel or change a request](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/cancel-or-change-a-request/).

articles.title: Invite people to a group
articles.summary: Send an email invite, share the invite code when the email doesn't arrive, and revoke invites.
articles.body:
You add people to a group by inviting their email address. Group admins, the group's manager and
organization administrators can invite; the Invites tab is hidden from
everyone else.

## Send an invite

1. Open the group from Groups and go to Invites.
2. Enter the person's email address under "Invite someone".
3. Press "Send invite".

Flexi Day emails them an invite link and a single-use code. The invite works only for that address
and expires after 14 days. Someone without an account creates one from the link and lands in the
group in one step.

## When the email doesn't arrive

The invite appears under "Pending invites" with its code. Press
"Copy code" and send the code another way. The person signs in, opens
Groups and enters it in "Join a group". A code needs an account whose email
address is confirmed. If the email failed to send, the tab tells you so straight away.

## Resend or withdraw an invite

To send a fresh invite, invite the same address again. The older invite stops working, code and link
alike. "Revoke" withdraws an invite without sending a new one.

## Group size

Pending invites count toward the plan's limit of people per group, as members do. When the group is
full, sending fails until you remove a member, revoke an invite or upgrade the plan. See
[Plans, prices and limits](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/plans-and-limits/).

## What the new member gets

They join with View and Tracked on, Admin and Approver off, and this year's allowance from the
group's defaults. Change their permissions on the Members tab. See
[Group permissions](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/group-permissions/).

articles.title: Use Flexi Day on your iPhone
articles.summary: What the iPhone app does, what stays on the web, and how its notifications and clock reminders work.
headings: What you can do in the app
articles.body:
The Flexi Day iPhone app shows the same time off, groups and quotas you see on the web, signed in to
the same account. There is no Android app.

## What you can do in the app

- See the dashboard calendar, with your group's time off, public holidays, group events and
  birthdays.
- Request time off, attach files, and cancel your own requests.
- Approve or decline requests waiting for you, and comment on them, if you are an approver.
- Read the report for the groups you may see.
- Clock in and out and take breaks, if your organization uses attendance.
- Join a group with an invite link or code, and see your groups' members and quotas.
- Read the people directory, if your organization has it.
- Change your birthday, password and two-factor authentication, and delete your account.

## What stays on the web

Creating an account and resetting a password happen on the web; the app links there. So do creating
a group, group settings and permissions, the Organization and Billing pages,
calendar sync, and connecting Google, Microsoft or Apple to your account. The Assistant is web only
too.

## Signing in

Sign in with your email and password, or with Google, Microsoft or Apple. Two-factor authentication
works as it does on the web. The app stays signed in until you sign out or reset your password, and
signing out removes everything the app stored for you from the phone.

## Notifications and clock reminders

When you allow notifications, the iPhone gets a notice when your time off is approved, declined or
commented on, and when a request waits for your approval. These are the same notices as the bell on
the web, and the email setting in Settings doesn't turn them off.

If your organization uses attendance, the app can also remind you to clock in at a time you pick on
the days you tick, skipping days off and holidays, and to clock out 15 minutes after today's required
time while you are still clocked in. The phone sets these reminders itself.

## Offline

The app keeps a copy of your time off, groups and quotas, so you can read them without a connection.
Changes, such as a new request or a clock-in, need a connection.

articles.title: Join a group with an invite
articles.summary: Use the link in your invite email or the invite code from your group admin to join a group.
articles.body:
A group admin invites you by email. The email holds an invite link and an invite code. Either one
gets you into the group, once.

## Join with the invite link

Open the link from your invite email. The page names the group and who invited you.

- **No account yet:** fill in your name and a password and press
  "Create account and join". Your account is created with the address confirmed, already in the
  group.
- **You have an account:** sign in, then press "Join group". Nothing happens until you press
  it.

## Join with the invite code

If the email didn't arrive, your group admin can copy the code and send it to you another way.

1. Sign in and open Groups.
2. In "Join a group", paste the code or the whole invite link into
   "Invite link or code".
3. Press "Join group".

Codes work in capitals or small letters, with or without their dashes. A code works only for an
account whose email address is confirmed. If yours isn't, use the link in the invite email: following
it confirms the address.

## Why an invite doesn't work

- **It is for another address.** An invite works only for the email address it was sent to. If you
  are signed in with a different account, sign out and continue with the invited one, or ask the
  admin to invite the address you use.
- **It expired.** An invite is valid for 14 days.
- **It was used or withdrawn.** Each invite works once. Sending a new invite to the same address
  cancels the older one.
- **The group is full.** Every plan limits the number of people in a group, and the organization may
  have reached it.

In each case, ask your group admin for a new invite.

## After you join

You land in the group as a member: you see the group's calendar, your leave is tracked there, and
you have this year's allowance from the group's defaults. A group admin can change your permissions.
See [Group permissions](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/group-permissions/).

articles.title: When a paid plan ends or a payment fails
articles.summary: The 14-day grace period, which groups turn read-only on the Free plan, and how to get everything back.
articles.body:
When a subscription is cancelled, paused or can't be paid, your organization keeps its paid plan for
a 14-day grace period. After that it falls back to the Free plan. Nothing is deleted at any point.

## During the grace period

Everything keeps working. Banners on the Billing page and across the app give the date
the grace period ends, and the billing email gets a warning. Update the card or subscribe again
before then and nothing changes.

## After the grace period

The organization is on the Free plan, and the plan badge on its groups reads
"lapsed".

- **Groups over the Free limits turn read-only.** Free allows 3 groups. The oldest groups stay
  usable and the newer ones turn read-only, together with any group that has more than 10 members.
  Extra group slots end with the subscription.
- **In a read-only group** nobody can book, approve or change settings, quotas or invites. Everyone
  can still see it, and admins can still remove members.
- **Paid features go dormant.** New attachments and group events can't be added, clocking in is
  refused, Sick days can't be requested, and on Enterprise the people directory and the Assistant
  stop. Files, records and settings stay.

Nothing you stored disappears. Bookings, quotas, attachments already uploaded and attendance stay
readable.

## Getting back under the limits

Either subscribe again, or bring the organization within the Free limits: remove members until each
group has 10 or fewer. Removing members works even in a read-only group, for this reason.

## Subscribe again

The owner subscribes from the Billing page. Every group turns writable and every paid
feature comes back as it was, with its settings and allowances. See
[Subscribe, change plan or cancel](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/manage-subscription/).

articles.title: Read the leave report for your team
articles.summary: What the Report page shows, whose data you see on it, and what each column of the Members table means.
articles.body:
The Report page sums up time off for the groups you belong to or administer: monthly
charts per leave type and a table of each member's allowance. Open it from the sidebar.

## Whose data you see

- In a group where you hold the View permission, or which you administer or manage, you see every
  member.
- In a group where you are a plain member, you see only your own rows.
- Organization administrators see every group of the organization, also groups they don't belong
  to.

Someone else's Sick leave, rejected requests and notes show only to that group's approvers and
admins, organization administrators included. Everyone else sees the person's other time off
without them. Your own rows are always complete.

If you are in no group with data for the year, the page shows "Nothing to report yet".

## Filter the report

The filter bar narrows everything on the page:

- **Period**: "Last 12 months" (the default) or one
  calendar year.
- **Groups**, **Members** and
  **Leave types**: pick one or several, or leave them on "all".

## The charts

Each leave type gets a "Monthly usage" panel with a bar per member per month and the total for the
window. Types with an allowance (Vacation,
Home Office, and Sick day where
the Sick day benefit is on) also get a "Days left" panel. Only the first panel opens by itself;
press a panel's title to open or close it. A half day counts 0.5.

## The Members table

One line per member, group and leave type with an allowance:

| Column                          | Meaning                                                           |
| ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Carried over | Unused days brought over from last year                           |
| Year quota   | The allowance for the year, or the group default if none is saved |
| Used to date  | Days already taken                                                |
| Planned     | Approved days still ahead this year                               |
| Pending     | Days waiting for approval                                         |
| Remaining   | Carried over plus year quota, minus used and planned              |

Pending days are not taken off Remaining, but a new request still counts them
against the allowance. See [Allowances](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/allowances/).

## One member's year

Press a member's name to open their detail page. It shows their allowance per group, monthly
charts, every booking of the year with its status, and "Changes by admins": each change
an admin made to their allowance, with who made it and when. Changes made at the turn of the year
show as made automatically.

Group admins, the manager and organization administrators also get
"Edit quota" there, for the current year only. It sets the allowance and the
days carried over; see [Year-end carry-over](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/year-rollover/).

To download the same data as a spreadsheet, see [Export the report to Excel](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/export-report/).

articles.title: Subscribe, change plan or cancel
articles.summary: How the owner subscribes, switches between plans and billing cycles, updates the card, gets invoices and cancels.
articles.body:
The Billing page shows your organization's plan, its usage and the plans you can move to.
Only the owner can change the subscription. Administrators see the same page with a note that they
can't change anything.

## Subscribe

1. Open Billing.
2. Under "Plans", pick "Monthly" or "Yearly".
3. Press "Subscribe" on Pro or Enterprise and pay in the checkout window.

Payments go through Paddle, which handles the card and adds VAT for your country. Confirming the
payment usually takes a few seconds; the page then shows the new plan. A first subscription starts
with a free trial; see [Plans, prices and limits](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/plans-and-limits/).

## Switch plan or billing cycle

With an active subscription, choose the other plan or billing cycle and press
"Switch to this plan". The change applies straight away, and the price difference is charged
or credited for the rest of the period.

## Card, invoices and cancelling

"Manage payment method" in the "Current plan" card opens the billing portal.
There you update your card, download invoices or cancel the plan.

A cancelled plan keeps working until the end of the period you paid for; the page shows the date as
"Cancels on". After that, a 14-day grace period starts and then the organization moves to the Free
plan. Nothing is deleted. See [When a paid plan ends](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/lapsed-plan/).

## Group slots

Add or remove extra group slots under "Extra group slots" with the plus and minus buttons,
then press "Update slots". Each slot costs €1.50 a month or
€15 a year, excluding VAT.

## Billing email

Subscription warnings, such as a failed payment, go to the organization's billing email. The owner
changes it on the Organization page under "Billing email".

## Payment overdue

When a payment fails, the plan shows "Payment overdue" and a banner tells you
the date until which everything keeps working. Update the card in the billing portal before then.

articles.title: Show someone's time off from another group with mirroring
articles.summary: Mirror a member's records from one group into another so both calendars show them, without a second approval.
articles.body:
Mirroring shows a member's time off from one group inside another group they also belong to. Use it
when a manager wants their own leave on their team's calendar, or when several small teams feed one
umbrella group.

## What a mirrored record is

A mirrored record is a view, not a copy. It is approved, counted against the allowance and reported
only in the group it was booked in. In the other group it is read-only: nobody approves it there, and
it shows with a dashed edge and "mirrored from" the source group's name. Teammates there see it the
way any teammate does, so Sick shows as
Away and notes stay hidden.

When the person leaves the target group, their records stop showing there.

## Set it up

You need to administer both groups: the one the records come from and the one they show in. The
member has to belong to both.

1. Open the group the records should show in and go to Mirroring.
2. Under "Mirror records into this group", find the member and tick the groups to mirror from.
   Only groups you administer and the member shares with this one are offered.
3. Press "Save mirroring".

A source group that someone else administers shows as locked; an admin of that group sets it.

## As a member

The Mirroring tab shows you which of your groups are mirrored into this one.
Only an admin of the group can change it.

## Where mirrored records show

They appear on the group's Dashboard calendar and on the Requests page when you
look at that group. Reports and the Excel export count each record only in its own group.

articles.title: Notifications and emails
articles.summary: What the bell in the top bar shows, which notices also come by email or to your iPhone, and how to turn request emails off.
articles.body:
Flexi Day tells you about things that need you, or that changed for you, with a notice under the
bell in the top bar. Some notices also come by email, and every one reaches the iPhone app if you
allow notifications there.

## The bell

A dot on the bell means you have unread notices. Open it to see the latest twelve, newest first.

- Click a notice to open what it is about. A request opens in its details window, on the page you
  are on.
- "Mark all read" clears the dot. "Clear all" removes every
  notice, and the cross beside one removes only that one.

## What you get notified about

| Notice                                                               | Who gets it                                                      | Email too |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| Someone requested time off                                           | The group's approvers and manager                                | Yes       |
| Your request was approved or declined                                | You                                                              | Yes       |
| Your request or approved time off was cancelled by someone else      | You                                                              | Yes       |
| You cancelled approved time off                                      | The group's approvers and manager                                | Yes       |
| A comment on a request                                               | The requester, or the approvers when the requester writes        | Yes       |
| An admin requested time off for you, or changed yours                | You                                                              | No        |
| Your clock was closed automatically                                  | You                                                              | No        |
| Your export is ready                                                 | Whoever asked for it                                             | No        |
| Someone deleted their account                                        | Their organization's admins, and whoever takes over their groups | No        |
| The people directory, the Assistant or AI connections were turned on | Everyone in the organization, if the owner chose to tell them    | No        |

Declined requests that are cancelled later send nothing more. Group events and birthdays never send
notices.

## Turn request emails off

Open Settings and switch off "Email notifications". It stops the emails
about requests: approval requests, decisions, cancellations and comments. The same notices still
appear under the bell and on your iPhone; the notices in the app can't be turned off. The setting
belongs to your account, so it applies in every organization.

Some emails always send, whatever the setting:

- confirming your email address, resetting your password and two-factor codes;
- invites to a group or to the people directory;
- warnings to the organization's billing email that the paid plan is ending.

## On your iPhone

The iPhone app shows the same notices as push notifications once you allow them. The email setting
doesn't affect them; turn them off in the iPhone's own settings. An auto-closed clock arrives quietly,
without a sound. See [Use Flexi Day on your iPhone](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/iphone-app/).

## Mail that doesn't arrive

See [Emails from Flexi Day don't arrive](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/email-not-arriving/).

articles.title: The owner and organization administrators
articles.summary: Who owns an organization, what an administrator can and can't do, and how the owner adds one.
articles.body:
An organization holds your company's groups and its plan. Flexi Day creates one the first time
someone creates a group, and that person becomes its owner. The Organization page shows
its details, plan, groups and administrators.

## The owner

The owner pays for the organization and has every right in it. Only the owner can:

- add and remove administrators;
- subscribe, change the plan, buy group slots and cancel, on the Billing page;
- change the "Billing email", where subscription warnings are sent;
- run the "Organization export" and turn the people directory on.

There is one owner per organization. Handing an organization over to someone else isn't available
yet.

## Administrators

An administrator manages every group in the organization without belonging to any of them: members
and permissions, quotas, invites, group settings and mirroring. An administrator can also rename the
organization, switch the Sick day benefit on or off, book leave for members, and see the
Billing page without changing anything.

An administrator can't approve or reject anyone's leave and can't book their own leave in a group
they don't belong to. In such a group, the group page says you are managing it as an administrator.
To decide on requests, a person needs the Approver permission inside the group. See
[Group permissions](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/group-permissions/).

## Add or remove an administrator

1. Open Organization and find "Administrators".
2. Press "Add administrator" and choose someone. The list holds the people in the
   organization's groups.

"Remove" takes the role away. An administrator who leaves their last group in
the organization loses the role too, unless the organization uses the people directory.

## More than one organization

You can work in groups of several organizations, for example as a member in your employer's and as
the owner of your own. The Organization page has a switcher at the top for the ones you
own or administer.

articles.title: Turn on the people directory and decide who sees what
articles.summary: What the Enterprise people directory is, how the owner turns it on or off, and how the Permission table and the HR and Leadership roles decide who reads and changes each part of a profile.
headings: Who sees what: the Permission table
articles.body:
The people directory keeps a profile for everyone your organization works with, including people
without a Flexi Day account and external workers. It is on the Enterprise plan, off until the owner
turns it on, and once on everyone in the organization finds it under Directory.

## Turn it on

1. The owner opens Organization and finds the "People directory" card.
2. Press "Turn on", read the directory agreement and accept it for the
   organization.
3. Leave "Tell members" ticked to send everyone with an account a
   notice asking them to check their profile.

Everyone employed in the organization appears under their account name. From then on, removing
someone from a group no longer ends their employment; see
[Employment and leaving](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/employment-spells/).

A checklist on the directory page then suggests the first steps: add departments, add locations,
assign HR and add job titles.

## The directory page

"People" lists everyone you can see, as cards or a table. Search by name or job
title, and filter by department or location. The owner, organization administrators and HR also get
"Former", the people who have left, and "Directory settings". Open
anyone to see their profile; see [Directory profiles](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/directory-profiles/).

## Who sees what: the Permission table

A profile has six sections: Card,
Photo, Work contact,
Job, Contact and
Personal. For each section, the
"Permission table" in Directory settings sets what each audience may
do: None, Read or
Write. The audiences are the table's columns:
Owner, Self,
Colleague, External worker,
Group admin, HR,
Leadership and
Org admin. Someone in several audiences gets the widest
cell.

By default:

- **Colleague:** reads Card,
  Photo and Work contact, and
  nothing of Job, Contact or
  Personal.
- **Self:** you read your whole profile and write your own
  Photo, Contact and
  Personal.
- **Group admin** and
  **Leadership:** read Card,
  Photo, Work contact and
  Job; a group admin of their group's members, Leadership of
  everyone.
- **HR** and
  **Org admin:** read and write every section of
  everyone.

The table also holds five acts: create a person without an account, send a directory invite, change
worker type, end an employment, and manage departments and locations. The owner, HR and org admins
may do them by default.

Only the owner changes the table. The owner always writes everything, and you always read your own
profile. Colleagues and external workers can get at most Read.
Every change is kept in the permission history.

## HR and Leadership

"Directory roles" are given to people, not groups. The owner assigns them in
Directory settings. They need an account and an open employment, end when the
employment ends, and being an org admin brings neither.

## Turn it off

The owner presses "Turn off" on the same card. Nobody's employment
ends, the directory closes for everyone and its data stays. Retention and the read log keep
working. "Delete all directory data" then removes profiles, photos, lists, roles and
people without an account for good; it needs the organization's name typed.

If the plan lapses, the directory stays readable, and data can be cleared but not added.

articles.title: Plans, prices and limits
articles.summary: What the Free, Pro and Enterprise plans include, what they cost, and how group and member limits work.
articles.body:
Every organization starts on the Free plan. The owner can move it to Pro or Enterprise on the
Billing page. Prices exclude VAT, which is added at checkout based on your country.

## The plans

| Plan       | Price                                                                      | Groups | People per group | Extra group slots |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ---------------- | ----------------- |
| Free       | free                                                                       | 3      | 10               | none              |
| Pro        | €8 a month or €80 a year               | 5      | 25               | up to 4           |
| Enterprise | €16 a month or €160 a year | 20     | 100              | up to 20          |

The price is for the whole organization, not per person. Paying yearly saves about 17%.

## What each plan adds

Free covers time off: groups, requests and approvals, quotas, reports, the Excel export and calendar
sync.

Pro and Enterprise add:

- attachments on requests (images and PDF);
- birthdays and group events on the group calendar;
- attendance with clock-in and worked time;
- the Sick day benefit;
- AI connections, which let apps such as Claude or ChatGPT work with Flexi Day.

Enterprise also adds the people directory with employee profiles, and the Assistant.

## Free trial

A first subscription starts with a free trial: 10 days on monthly billing, 2 months on yearly. You
are billed from the day it ends. An organization that already had a subscription gets no new trial
when it switches plans.

## Group slots

On a paid plan, the owner can buy extra group slots on the Billing page, under
"Extra group slots". Each slot adds one group and costs €1.50 a month or
€15 a year. Slots are charged straight away, even during a trial.

## How the limits count

- **Groups.** Every group in the organization counts. When all are used, creating a group shows
  that the plan's groups are used up.
- **People per group.** Members and open invites both count, so a group at its limit can't send
  more invites. Remove a member or revoke an invite to make room.

The "Usage" card on the Billing page shows groups used and the size
of each group. There is no limit on the number of people across the organization.

Some organizations have a custom plan with limits agreed with Flexi Day. Their Billing
page shows those limits.

articles.title: Request time off
articles.summary: Book vacation or other leave for a day or a range, and what happens after you submit.
articles.body:
You request time off in a group you belong to. The request waits until an approver of that group
decides it.

## Open the request form

- Press "+ New Request" in the top bar. Where your groups can take group events, the
  button reads "+ New"; choose "Time off request".
- Or, on the Dashboard calendar, click a day, or drag across several days on a computer.
  The form opens with those dates.

## Fill it in

1. **Group**: the group the time off belongs to, if you are in more than one.
2. **Type**: see [Types of time off](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/types-of-time-off/).
3. **From** and **To**: the first and last day, both included.
   Pick the same day twice for a single day. You can book from 1 January this year to 31 December
   next year.
4. Optional times, half day and note. See [Half days and times](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/half-days-and-times/). A note is
   required for Other.
5. Press "Submit Request".

On a paid plan, you can attach files once the request is sent. See
[Attach files to a request](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/attachments/).

## Which days get booked

Flexi Day books one day for each working day in the range. Days the group doesn't work and public
holidays of its country are skipped and cost nothing. A range with no working day in it is refused.

You can hold only one booking per day. If a day in the range is already booked, pending or approved,
the whole request is refused and the message lists the days. Cancel the existing request first, or
pick other dates. Cancelled and rejected days are free again.

For types with an allowance, the request is refused when it would take you past what you have left
for that year, counting your pending requests too. See [Allowances](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/allowances/).

## After you submit

The request shows as Pending. The group's approvers get an email and a notice in the
app. You get one when it is approved or declined. Track it on the Requests page or under
"Your requests" on the Dashboard.

## Booking for a member

Group admins, the manager and organization administrators can book for someone in the group. In the
form, choose the person under "For". "Approve immediately"
is ticked by default and creates the request already approved by you. Untick it to send the request
through the normal approval; the member is told it was filed for them.

articles.title: Offer paid sick days with the Sick day benefit
articles.summary: Turn on the Sick day benefit so members can request Sick days against a yearly allowance.
headings: Turning it off, and lapsed plans
articles.body:
The Sick day benefit lets members request a Sick day: a paid day
off from a yearly allowance, no illness needed. It is off until an administrator turns it on, and it
needs a paid plan.

Sick day is not the same as Sick.
Sick records an absence due to illness, has no allowance, and is
open to everyone.

## Turn it on

1. Open Organization. The owner or an administrator can do this.
2. In "Sick day benefit", switch on "Offer paid sick days".

Then set the allowances. Group admins give each member a number of Sick days for the year in the
group's Quotas tab, and can set a starting value for new members under
"Group defaults". See [Allowances](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/allowances/).

## How members use it

Sick day appears under "Others" in the request
form, in groups whose organization has the benefit on. It goes through the same approval as any
request, and "My balance" on the Dashboard shows the days left.

Unused Sick days don't carry over into the next year. Teammates see a Sick day under its own name;
only Sick is shown to them as "Away".

## Turning it off, and lapsed plans

Turning the benefit off stops new Sick day requests. Allowances and booked Sick days stay, and
turning it on again brings everything back.

If the paid plan lapses, the benefit goes dormant the same way: nothing is deleted, the setting stays
on, and Sick days become requestable again once the organization subscribes again. Sick days already
booked can still be edited during a lapse.

articles.title: Sign in, reset your password and use two-factor authentication
articles.summary: Sign in with a password or with Google, Microsoft or Apple, reset a forgotten password, and add a second step.
headings: Sign in with Google, Microsoft or Apple
articles.body:
Sign in on the sign-in page with your email and password, or with Google, Microsoft or Apple if you
connected one of them to your account.

## Forgot your password

1. On the sign-in page, choose "Forgot?".
2. Enter your email and press "Send reset link".
3. Follow the link in the email and set a new password of at least 8 characters. The link is valid
   for one hour.

Setting a new password signs you out everywhere else, including your phone, and disconnects every AI
app you connected ([AI connections](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/ai-connections/)). If you never confirmed your email address,
the reset confirms it.

## Change your password

When you know your current password, change it in the "Change password" card in
Settings. An account that only ever signed in with Google, Microsoft or Apple has no
password. To add one, sign out and use "Forgot?"; the link sets it. Changing it
signs you out everywhere else and disconnects your AI apps, like a reset.

## Sign in with Google, Microsoft or Apple

Connect a provider in the "Sign-in methods" card in Settings. The
provider account has to use the same email address as your Flexi Day account. After that the
matching button on the sign-in page signs you in. You can disconnect a method there too, as long as
another way to sign in remains.

Signing in with a provider whose address already has a Flexi Day account, without connecting it
first, is refused. Sign in the way you did before, then connect the provider from
Settings.

## Two-factor authentication

Two-factor authentication adds a second step to password sign-in. Sign-in with Google, Microsoft or
Apple doesn't ask for it.

To turn it on, open Settings, find "Two-factor authentication" and press
"Enable two-factor". Confirm your password, then pick your second step:

- **Authenticator app**: scan the QR code with an app such as Google
  Authenticator or 1Password and enter the 6-digit code it shows.
- **Email code**: Flexi Day emails you a 6-digit code at each sign-in. It
  expires after three minutes.

Then save your backup codes. Each one signs you in once when you can't reach your authenticator or
your email, and they are shown only once. "New backup codes" makes a fresh
set.

When you sign in, tick "Trust this device for 30 days" to skip the second step on that browser
for 30 days. Too many wrong codes lock the account for a few minutes.

articles.title: See and correct your team's attendance
articles.summary: What group admins and organization administrators see on Team attendance, what its marks mean, and how to correct, add or check someone's session.
articles.body:
Team attendance shows the attendance of the people you administer: who is in now, each
person's worked time per day, and the days that need a look. It appears in the sidebar for group
admins and organization administrators while attendance is on.

## Who you see

| You are                           | You see                                                   |
| --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| Group admin, or a group's manager | The members of the groups you administer                  |
| Organization administrator, owner | Everyone in the organization, people in no group included |

A group's manager is never one of that group's members, so other admins of the group don't see the
manager's attendance; organization administrators do. External workers don't appear.

On days off, someone's Sick shows as Away unless you approve or
administer the group the absence was booked in.

## Read the dashboard

- **"In now"** lists who is clocked in right now, and who is on a break.
- Pick "Week", "Month" or
  "Range" (at most 93 days). Filter by group, or by organization if you
  administer several.
- Each cell is one person's worked time on one day. Hatched days owe no attendance.

The marks:

- **Auto-closed:** the session ran past the ceiling and closed by itself; the real time still needs
  setting. See [Forgotten clock-outs](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/attendance-ceilings/).
- **Still open:** a session running from an earlier day.
- **Excluded day:** someone clocked in on a day off; the time counts toward the month.
- **Entered:** recorded after the fact rather than clocked, for good.
- **Changed later:** the person changed it after the day, until you correct it or mark it checked.

The line about employee self-service at the top says what members may fix themselves.
Organization administrators change it with "Change".

## Correct or add a session

- Open a person's day to correct their clock-in, clock-out or breaks, or to delete a session. Every
  change is kept in the session's history with your name.
- Press "Add" in an empty cell to enter a session for them. It is
  marked "Entered", and they see it that way.

Admins can change any day of the person's employment, also after it ended. While the plan is
lapsed, attendance can be read but not changed.

## Mark as checked

When a person changed a session after its day, it stays flagged until you look at it. If their
change is right, open the day and press "Mark as checked". That moves no time. If it
is wrong, correct it, which clears the flag too. There is no approval step: the admin is the
authority.

articles.title: Types of time off
articles.summary: The record types you can book, which ones draw on an allowance, and what each is for.
articles.body:
Every request has a type. The request form shows the three common ones as buttons and the rest under
"Others".

## The types

| Type                                            | Use it for                                                   | Allowance           |
| ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------- |
| Vacation       | Paid annual leave. The default on a new request.             | Yes, carries over   |
| Home Office    | Working remotely: away from the office, not from work.       | Yes                 |
| Sick           | Absence due to illness.                                      | No                  |
| Paid Time Off  | Paid absence that is neither annual leave nor a benefit day. | No                  |
| Non-Paid Leave | Unpaid absence.                                              | No                  |
| Study Leave    | Time spent studying, kept apart from vacation.               | No                  |
| Sick day       | A paid day off from the Sick day benefit, no illness needed. | Yes, where it is on |
| Other          | Anything else. A note saying what it is is required.         | No                  |
| Bank Holiday   | A company-wide closure. Not offered in the request form.     | No                  |

## Which types use an allowance

Vacation, Home Office and
Sick day each draw on their own yearly allowance in the group. A
request that would take you past it is refused. Only unused vacation days carry over into the next
year. See [Allowances](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/allowances/) and [Year-end carry-over](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/year-rollover/).

The other types book without any limit, but they still need approval and still show on the calendar
and in reports.

## Sick and Sick day

Sick day appears only in groups whose organization has turned on
the Sick day benefit on a paid plan. See [Sick day benefit](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/sick-day-benefit/).
Sick is always available. Teammates see a
Sick record only as "Away", and
reports leave it out for them. See [Who sees your time off](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/who-sees-your-time-off/).

## External workers

An external worker can book only types that draw on no allowance, such as
Non-Paid Leave.

articles.title: Who sees your time off
articles.summary: What teammates, approvers and admins see of your requests, and how sick leave and notes stay private.
articles.body:
Your time off is visible to your group, but some details stay with you and the people who manage your
leave.

## What teammates see

Teammates are the people in your group with the View permission. On the calendar and the
Requests page they see:

- that you are off, on which days, and the type of time off;
- Sick only as "Away";
- pending and approved requests, but never your declined or cancelled ones.

They don't see your note, the reason for a decision, the comments, the history or the attachments.

## What approvers and admins see

The approvers and admins of the group your request belongs to, including organization
administrators, see everything: the real type, the note, comments, history and attachments. These
are the request's private details.

A record mirrored into another group shows there the way it shows to teammates, even to that group's
approvers and admins. Its private details stay with the group it was booked in.

## Members without View

A member without the View permission sees only their own time off in the group, not anyone else's.
A group admin can turn View on. See [Group permissions](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/group-permissions/).

## Reports

In the report, the same rule holds: people who see your record only as a teammate never see your
Sick days there.

articles.title: Worked time, required time and your balance
articles.summary: How Flexi Day turns sessions and breaks into worked time, which days owe no attendance, and how the daily or monthly balance is counted.
articles.body:
My attendance shows, for each day, how long you were present, how much counts as worked,
what the day required and the difference. Switch between "Day",
"Week" and "Month" to see it.

## How worked time is counted

- **Presence** is the total of your sessions that day, breaks included.
- **Breaks deducted:** if presence passes the threshold (6 hours by default), the larger of the break
  allowance (30 minutes by default) and the breaks you took is deducted. Below the threshold, only
  the breaks you took are.
- **Worked** is presence minus that.

So the allowance comes off a long day even if you never pressed "Take a break", and a
longer break comes off in full. Your organization sets both numbers.

## Required time

**Required** is your organization's required time per day (8 hours by default), unless
an admin gave you your own. A half-day absence halves it for that day.

## Days that owe nothing

No attendance is owed on a day that is:

- outside your employment, before it began or after it ended;
- not one of the organization's working days;
- a public holiday in the organization's holiday country;
- covered by an approved absence such as Vacation or
  Sick, in any group of the organization.

Home Office still owes time: working from home is working. A request
waiting for approval excuses nothing yet. These days show hatched on your week and month.

You can still clock in on such a day. It is flagged "Excluded day" and the time
counts toward the month.

## Your balance

**Balance** is worked minus required. Your organization shows it one of two ways:

- **Each day:** every day is coloured against its own required time.
- **Over the month:** one "Month balance" against the month's required time.

Mid-month, the balance counts only working days already begun, so days still to come are no
shortfall. "Month required" beside it shows what the whole month asks for.

Nothing is enforced. Balances don't carry over into the next month and don't reset; they are
reported and left to your employer.

## Why an old day changed

The rules are read when a day is shown, not when it was worked. If your organization changes the
required time, break rules, working days or holiday country, past balances move too. Only a
session's day and its timezone stay as they were at clock-in.

articles.title: Year-end carry-over of unused days
articles.summary: What happens to allowances on 1 January, how unused vacation days carry over, and how an admin corrects the result.
articles.body:
On the first night of a new year, Flexi Day opens the new year's allowances for everyone in every
group, by itself. Unused vacation days come along; nothing else carries over.

## What the new year gets

For each member of each group:

- **Vacation, Home Office and
  Sick days** start at the same yearly numbers as last year. A member who had no allowance of their
  own last year starts from the group defaults.
- **Carried over** gets last year's unused vacation days: last year's vacation allowance, plus what
  was carried into it, minus the vacation days booked. Pending days count as booked, and the result is
  rounded down to whole days.
- Unused Home Office and Sick days expire.

Carried-over days add to the new year's vacation allowance, so "My balance" on
the Dashboard shows them in the total.

## When it runs

Every night, Flexi Day opens the current year for anyone who doesn't have it yet. So the new year
appears on the first night of January, and a member who joins later gets theirs from the group
defaults when they join. An allowance an admin already saved for the year is never overwritten.

Each automatic change appears under "Changes by admins" on the member's page in the
Report, marked "automatically at the turn of the year".

## Correct the carry-over

A group admin, the manager or an organization administrator opens the member's page in the
Report and presses "Edit quota". The dialog shows
"Carried over from previous year" with a suggestion based on last year's unused days, which
they can accept or override. Only the current year can be edited there. The yearly numbers can also
be changed on the group's Quotas tab; see [Allowances](https://www.flexi-day.com/help/allowances/).

## Cancelling last year's days later

Carry-over is worked out once, on the night it runs. Cancelling a request from last year after that
doesn't change the carried-over number; ask a group admin to correct it.

## External workers

External workers get no allowance in the new year either, so nothing carries over for them.

cs.overview:
Flexi Day je sdílený kalendář pro volno a docházku. Lidé patří do organizace, která má jednu nebo
více skupin. Každá skupina má vlastní pracovní dny, zemi svátků, členy a schvalovatele.

## Co lidé ve Flexi Day dělají

- **Volno.** Členové posílají žádosti o dovolenou a jiné nepřítomnosti na stránce
  Žádosti. Schvalovatelé ve skupině je schvalují nebo zamítají. Nároky hlídají, kolik
  dní má každý člověk v roce.
- **Kalendář.** Přehled ukazuje, kdo je pryč. Stránka Report shrnuje volno
  skupiny nebo člověka a nabízí export do Excelu.
- **Synchronizace kalendáře.** Volno se může zobrazovat v kalendářích Google nebo Microsoft přes
  odběr nebo přímou synchronizaci.
- **Docházka.** Pokud ji organizace zapne, lidé zaznamenávají příchod a odchod a správci
  skupin a správci organizace vidí odpracovaný čas na stránce Docházka týmu.
- **Adresář.** V tarifu Enterprise vede adresář lidí pracovní poměry a profily.
- **Skupinové akce a narozeniny** se zobrazují v kalendáři vedle volna.

## Role

Vlastník platí za organizaci a může jmenovat správce organizace. Každá skupina má vedoucího,
schvalovatele a členy. Co člověk vidí a může měnit, závisí na těchto rolích.

## Tarify

Organizace začínají v tarifu Free. Pro stojí 8 € měsíčně a Enterprise
16 € měsíčně, bez DPH. Tarif spravuje vlastník na stránce
Fakturace.

## Funkce AI

Asistent je chat ve webové aplikaci v tarifu Enterprise. AI připojení umožní aplikacím jako Claude
nebo ChatGPT pracovat s Flexi Day v tarifech Pro a Enterprise. Každou z těchto funkcí zapíná
vlastník.

articles.title: Změna nastavení
articles.summary: E-mailová oznámení, vzhled kalendáře na přehledu, jazyk a motiv, a kde najdeš ostatní nastavení účtu.
articles.body:
Nastavení otevřeš z postranního panelu nebo z uživatelského menu v horní liště. Tato
nastavení patří k tvému účtu, takže platí ve všech organizacích, kde pracuješ.

## E-mailová oznámení

„E-mailová oznámení“ řídí e-maily, které Flexi Day posílá k žádostem: žádosti o
schválení pro schvalovatele, rozhodnutí o tvých žádostech, zrušení a komentáře. Když je vypneš,
dostaneš tyto novinky jen v aplikaci, ve zvonečku v horní liště, a v iPhonu, pokud aplikaci
používáš. E-maily k účtu, třeba potvrzení adresy nebo obnovení hesla, chodí vždy. Viz
[Oznámení a e-maily](https://www.flexi-day.com/cs/help/notifications/).

## Kalendář na přehledu

Karta „Kalendář na nástěnce“ určuje, jak se kalendář na stránce Přehled
otevře:

- **Rozvržení.** „Pruhy“ ukazuje v kalendáři jména.
  „Kompaktní“ udrží měsíc kompaktní; kdo je pryč, uvidíš po výběru dne.
  Aplikace pro iPhone používá stejnou volbu.
- **Čí volno zobrazovat.** „Jen já“ nebo
  „Moje skupina“. U skupiny vyber, kterou. V seznamu jsou jen skupiny, jejichž volno
  smíš vidět; oprávnění k zobrazení ti může dát správce skupiny.

Na samotném přehledu můžeš i tak pro jednu návštěvu přepnout mezi sebou a skupinou.

## Jazyk a motiv

Mezi angličtinou a češtinou přepneš tlačítkem jazyka v horní liště; volba se uloží k tvému účtu.
Tlačítko motivu vybere světlý, tmavý nebo motiv podle systému.

## Jméno a e-mailová adresa

Tvoje jméno a e-mailová adresa jsou ty, se kterými ses registroval. Aplikace zatím nemá pole, kde
bys je změnil.

## Další nastavení na této stránce

- **Narozeniny**: jestli tvoje skupiny uvidí tvoje narozeniny ve svém kalendáři. Viz
  [Přidání narozenin a jejich sdílení](https://www.flexi-day.com/cs/help/birthdays/).
- **Způsoby přihlášení**, **Změnit heslo** a
  **Dvoufázové ověření**: viz [Přihlášení do Flexi Day](https://www.flexi-day.com/cs/help/sign-in/).
- **AI připojení**: AI aplikace, které jsi připojil, s odpojením. Viz
  [Připoj k Flexi Day AI aplikaci](https://www.flexi-day.com/cs/help/ai-connections/).
- **Vaše data** a **Smazat účet**: viz
  [Stažení dat a smazání účtu](https://www.flexi-day.com/cs/help/delete-your-account/).

articles.title: Limity AI připojení
articles.summary: Denní limit AI připojení, denní limit člena a limity pro každou aplikaci, a co AI aplikace uslyší, když některý vyčerpá.
articles.body:
AI připojení mají limity, aby jedna aplikace nebo jeden člověk nevyčerpali, co sdílí celá
organizace. Počítají se jen volání nástrojů. Připojení, výpis toho, co aplikace umí, a kontrola
spojení se nepočítají.

## Denní limity

- **Denní limit AI připojení**: kolik volání smí za den udělat všechna AI připojení organizace
  dohromady. 5 000 v tarifu Pro, 20 000 v tarifech Enterprise a Custom.
- **Denní limit člena**: 1 000 na člověka v každé organizaci, aby jedna zacyklená aplikace
  nevyčerpala den celé organizace.

Oba se obnovují o půlnoci UTC. Vlastník vidí obě čísla, když zapíná AI připojení v kartě AI na
stránce Organizace.

## Limity pro každou aplikaci

Každá aplikace, kterou někdo připojil, smí udělat 300 volání nástrojů za 5 minut a 30 změn za
hodinu. Změna je vytvoření nebo zrušení žádosti, příchod nebo odchod; každá může poslat e-maily,
a proto mají změny nižší limit. Druhá aplikace téhož člověka má vlastní limity.

## Když se limit vyčerpá

Aplikace dostane zprávu v jazyce tvé aplikace, který limit vyčerpala a kdy se obnoví, aby ti to
mohla říct. Do té doby se její volání odmítají. Flexi Day samotné funguje dál, stejně jako tvoje
další aplikace, pokud organizace nevyčerpala denní limit AI připojení, který sdílí všechny
aplikace v ní. Nikomu nepřijde e-mail ani upozornění.

articles.title: Připoj k Flexi Day AI aplikaci
articles.summary: Nech AI aplikaci, jako je Claude, ChatGPT nebo Cursor, číst tvoje údaje ve Flexi Day a dělat za tebe změny.
articles.body:
AI připojení umožní AI aplikaci, kterou už používáš, třeba Claude, ChatGPT nebo Cursor, pracovat s
tvými údaji ve Flexi Day. Aplikace jedná jako ty, v jedné organizaci a se stejnými oprávněními, jaká
máš v aplikaci.

## Než začneš

AI připojení fungují v každém placeném tarifu: Pro, Enterprise i Custom. Vlastník vybere jedno ze
tří nastavení pro „AI připojení“ v kartě AI na stránce
Organizace:

- **Vypnuto**, výchozí stav: žádná aplikace se nepřipojí.
- **Jen čtení**: aplikace čtou to, co vidíš ty.
- **Čtení a zápis**: aplikace navíc můžou měnit tvoje vlastní
  záznamy.

## Zapnutí AI připojení

Nastavení může změnit jen vlastník. Správci organizace ho vidí, ale změnit ho nemůžou, a v tarifu
Free zůstává vypnuté. Než se AI připojení zapnou, vlastník si přečte, co aplikace umí a co opouští
Flexi Day: co aplikace přečte, jde ke společnosti, která za ní stojí, podle vlastní smlouvy člena s
ní. Osobní účty AI aplikací si mohou přečtená data uchovat nebo na nich trénovat, takže které
aplikace můžou lidé používat, určují pravidla vaší organizace.

Úroveň, se kterou začne, vybere vlastník v části „Začít s“.
Když se nějaká funkce AI zapíná poprvé, vlastník přijme za organizaci Smlouvu o funkcích AI a Flexi
Day zaznamená, kdo ji přijal, kdy a kterou verzi. Pokud aktuální verzi už přijal při zapnutí
Asistenta, AI připojení se znovu neptají.

„Dát vědět členům“ je ve výchozím stavu zaškrtnuté a pošle všem v organizaci
upozornění v aplikaci a v telefonu. Dokud jsou AI připojení zapnutá, vlastník zkopíruje stejný text
z karty AI tlačítkem „Zkopírovat upozornění pro členy“.

Přechod z Jen čtení na
Čtení a zápis nové přijetí smlouvy nepotřebuje. Snížení na
Jen čtení nebo vypnutí AI připojení musí vlastník nejdřív
potvrdit a dialog vyjmenuje aplikace a lidi, které odpojí. Každá změna se zaznamená i s tím, kdo ji
udělal a kdy.

## Připojení aplikace

1. Otevři Nastavení a najdi kartu „AI připojení“.
2. V části „Připojit AI aplikaci“ zkopíruj adresu serveru,
   `https://api.flexi-day.com/mcp`.
3. V AI aplikaci přidej vlastní konektor s touto adresou.
4. Aplikace otevře stránku Flexi Day, která ji jmenuje. Přihlas se jako obvykle. Pokud používáš
   dvoufázové ověření, Flexi Day si řekne o kód. Dokud přístup nepovolíš, nic se nesdílí.
5. Vyber organizaci, ve které má aplikace pracovat. U každé vidíš, jaký přístup povoluje.
   Organizace, kde vlastník AI připojení nezapnul nebo které mají tarif Free, jsou uvedené i s
   důvodem. Pokud to nepovoluje žádná, vrať se do aplikace.
6. Zkontroluj stránku se souhlasem a zvol „Povolit“.

Každé připojení platí pro jednu organizaci a vybíráš ji při každém připojení. Další přidáš novým
připojením.

### Stránka se souhlasem

- Když Flexi Day mohl adresu aplikace ověřit, stránka ukáže „Adresa ověřena“ i s adresou. Jinak
  napíše „Název není ověřený“: název uvádí sama aplikace.
- Když je aplikace program v tvém počítači, třeba Claude Code nebo Cursor, upozornění tě požádá,
  abys ji povolil jen tehdy, když jsi připojení z ní právě spustil.
- „Vidět, co vidíte vy“ je součástí každého připojení. „Provádět změny za vás“ je
  zaškrtnuté; odškrtni ho a připojíš jen pro čtení. V organizaci s nastavením Jen čtení se nenabízí.

## Co připojená aplikace umí

Čte všechno, co ve Flexi Day vidíš ty, a hledá v nápovědě. Při nastavení Čtení a zápis navíc
vytvoří žádost, zruší tvoji žádost a zaznamená tvůj příchod nebo odchod, jen za tebe. Změna proběhne hned, podle pravidel aplikace. Žádosti schvalovat ani
zamítat neumí (to udělej ve Flexi Day nebo požádej [Asistenta](https://www.flexi-day.com/cs/help/assistant/)) a nemění role, fakturaci ani
nastavení.

Změna od aplikace má v historii žádosti nebo docházky poznámku
„přes AI aplikaci“. Když otevře citlivou sekci něčího profilu, ukáže se toto čtení stejně
i v Záznamu o čtení organizace.

## Limity

Každá organizace má denní limit AI připojení, každý člověk denní limit člena a každá aplikace navíc
vlastní limity. V článku [Limity AI připojení](https://www.flexi-day.com/cs/help/ai-connection-limits/) najdeš čísla a co
aplikace uslyší, když některý vyčerpá.

## Tvoje připojení a odpojení

Karta „AI připojení“ v Nastavení ukazuje každou aplikaci,
kterou jsi připojil: její adresu, nebo „název neověřen“, když ji
Flexi Day nemohl ověřit, organizaci, přístup a kdy byla naposledy použita. Poslední použití se u používané
aplikace aktualizuje aspoň jednou za hodinu.

Připojení ukončíš tak, že u aplikace zvolíš „Odpojit“ a
potvrdíš to. Aplikace přestane fungovat při svém dalším volání. Pokud ji chceš používat znovu,
připoj ji znovu.

### Co dalšího aplikace odpojí

- Obnovení hesla odpojí všechny aplikace, které jsi připojil, ve všech organizacích.
- Změna hesla v Nastavení udělá totéž, protože tě zároveň odhlásí všude jinde.
- Smazání účtu je odpojí všechny.
- Když vlastník AI připojení vypne, odpojí se všechny aplikace v organizaci. Když nastavení sníží na
  Jen čtení, odpojí se aplikace s přístupem k zápisu; novým
  připojením získáš přístup ke čtení.
- Vlastník a správci organizace vidí aplikace každého člověka na stránce Využití AI a můžou je tam
  odebrat.

Odhlášení, zapnutí dvoufázového ověření ani propadlý tarif tvoje připojení nezruší. Dokud je tarif propadlý, aplikace dostává na svá volání odmítnutí.

articles.title: Stránka Využití AI
articles.summary: Co vlastník a správci organizace vidí na stránce Využití AI, od útraty Asistenta po AI aplikace jednotlivých lidí, a jak aplikaci odvolat.
articles.body:
Stránka Využití AI ukazuje, co v jedné organizaci využívá Asistent a AI aplikace vašich
členů. Vidí ji jen vlastník a správci organizace. Otevřete ji přes Využití AI v sekci
Organizace v postranním panelu, přes „Zobrazit využití AI“ na AI
kartě stránky Organizace nebo přes „Zobrazit využití“, když se Asistent
pozastaví. Pokud spravujete víc organizací, vyberte jednu nahoře.

Ukazuje, kolik kdo využil a kolik jeho zpráv bylo odmítnuto, nikdy ne to, co kdo napsal.

## Asistent tento týden

Kolik z Týdenního limitu organizace je vyčerpáno, v dolarech a v procentech, a kdy se limit
obnoví, ve vašem časovém pásmu. Počítají se i odpovědi, které se ještě píšou, takže částka může po
jejich dokončení trochu klesnout. Sloupce ukazují posledních osm týdnů vedle tohoto, týdny s
vyčerpaným limitem červeně. Po vyčerpání limitu karta řekne kdy a že je Asistent pozastavený pro
všechny do obnovení. Viz [Týdenní limit a využití](https://www.flexi-day.com/cs/help/assistant-weekly-limit/).

## AI připojení dnes

Volání nástrojů všech AI aplikací dnes oproti dennímu limitu AI připojení, kdy se počet obnoví, a
sloupce za posledních 14 dní, dny s vyčerpaným limitem červeně. Viz
[Limity AI připojení](https://www.flexi-day.com/cs/help/ai-connection-limits/).

## Lidé

Jeden řádek pro každého, kdo tento týden použil Asistenta, měl odmítnutou zprávu, dnes volal nebo
má připojenou AI aplikaci:

- **Asistent tento týden**: kolik tento týden stály jeho odpovědi Asistenta.
- **Odmítnuto**: zprávy, které Asistent tento týden odmítl jako mimo téma nebo
  nebezpečné. Od 3 je číslo oranžové.
- **AI volání dnes**: dnešní volání jeho AI aplikací, označená, jakmile dosáhnou
  denního limitu člena.
- **Připojené aplikace**: aplikace, které v této organizaci připojil.

Využití účtu, který byl smazán a vymazán, se ukazuje jako „Deleted account“
bez jména, aby součty seděly. Na telefonu je každý člověk jedna karta.

## Odvolání aplikace

Otevřete člověka a uvidíte jeho aplikace s přístupem, datem připojení a posledním použitím.
Stiskněte Odvolat a pak znovu Odvolat pro potvrzení.
Aplikace přestane fungovat při dalším volání. Člověk ji může znovu připojit, dokud jsou AI
připojení zapnutá, a své aplikace si může odpojit sám v Nastavení. Viz
[AI připojení](https://www.flexi-day.com/cs/help/ai-connections/).

## Předchozí týdny

Všechny dřívější týdny, kdy se Asistent používal, od nejnovějšího, s datem vyčerpání limitu, pokud
k němu došlo. Otevřete týden a uvidíte, kdo kolik využil. Využití po lidech se uchovává 180 dní;
starší týdny ukazují jen součet za organizaci.

Pokud jsou Asistent i AI připojení vypnuté, stránka to řekne a odkáže na nastavení organizace.

articles.title: Nároky a kolik dní ti zbývá
articles.summary: Jak fungují roční nároky podle skupiny a typu, kde uvidíš, co zbývá, a jak je správci nastavují.
articles.body:
Nárok je počet dní, které si člověk může zadat jednoho typu za jeden rok v jedné skupině. Nárok mají
tři typy: Dovolená, Home Office a
Zdravotní volno tam, kde je zapnutý benefit zdravotního volna. Čísla jsou
vlastní pro tvoji organizaci; nastavují je správci skupin.

## Kolik ti zbývá

„Můj zůstatek“ na stránce Přehled ukazuje u každého typu s nárokem, kolik
dní ti letos zbývá z celku, sečteno za tvoje skupiny. Dny čekající na schválení jsou uvedené vedle.
Záložka Kvóty skupiny ukazuje nárok každého člena na daný rok, pokud tam máš
oprávnění Zobrazení.

## Jak se nárok čerpá

- Každá skupina má vlastní nároky. Volno zadané ve skupině čerpá z nároku této skupiny.
- Den se počítá do roku, do kterého spadá. Půlden se počítá jako 0,5.
- Novou žádost aplikace odmítne, pokud by tvoje schválené a čekající dny spolu s novými nárok
  překročily. Zrušením žádosti se její dny vrátí.
- Nevyčerpané dny typu Dovolená se převádějí do dalšího roku; viz
  [Převod dní na konci roku](https://www.flexi-day.com/cs/help/year-rollover/).

Pokud ti aplikace žádost z tohoto důvodu odmítla, požádej správce skupiny o navýšení nároku.

## Nastavení nároku člena

Může to udělat správce skupiny, manažer a správci organizace.

1. Otevři skupinu ze stránky Skupiny a přejdi na Kvóty.
2. Šipkami vyber rok.
3. U člena stiskni „Upravit“, změň čísla a ulož.

Člen, který na daný rok nemá uložený nárok, ukazuje výchozí hodnotu skupiny s označením
„(výchozí)“. Uložením se zapíše jeho vlastní číslo. Každá změna se zaznamená i s
tím, kdo ji udělal, v části „Změny provedené administrátory“ na stránce člena v sekci
Report.

Dny převedené z minulého roku se nastavují přes „Upravit nárok“ na téže stránce,
která navrhne nevyčerpané dny z předchozího roku.

## Výchozí hodnoty skupiny

V části „Výchozí hodnoty skupiny“ v záložce Kvóty nastaví správci
nároky, se kterými začínají noví členové. Uložíš je tlačítkem „Uložit výchozí hodnoty“.
Výchozí hodnoty platí pro členy, kteří na daný rok ještě nárok nemají; stávající nároky se nemění.

## Externí spolupracovníci

Externí spolupracovníci nárok nemají a zadat si můžou jen typy bez nároku.

articles.title: Schválení nebo zamítnutí žádostí o volno
articles.summary: Kde schvalovatelé najdou čekající žádosti, jak je schválit nebo zamítnout s důvodem a kdo smí rozhodovat.
articles.body:
O žádostech ve skupině rozhodují její schvalovatelé: členové s oprávněním Schvalovatel a manažer
skupiny. Když na tebe žádost čeká, dostaneš e-mail a upozornění v aplikaci.

## Kde najdeš čekající žádosti

- **Přehled:** karta „Čekající schválení“ vypisuje, co čeká na tebe, s
  tlačítky „Schválit“ a „Zamítnout“.
- **Žádosti:** vyber skupinu a měsíce a pak filtr „Čekající“.
  Každý řádek je jedna celá žádost s tlačítky „Schválit“ a „Zamítnout“.
- **Kalendář:** klikni na žádost a otevřou se její podrobnosti.

## Rozhodnutí s důvodem

V podrobnostech žádosti uvidíš data, typ, poznámku, soubory a historii. Napiš do pole komentář nebo
důvod a stiskni „Schválit“ nebo „Zamítnout“. Komentář se
objeví v historii žádosti a člen dostane upozornění na rozhodnutí.

Rozhodnutí platí pro celou žádost, pro každý její den. Zamítnutí je konečné; člen si v případě
potřeby zadá žádost znovu. Schválenou žádost jde později ještě zrušit, a to členem i tebou.

Chceš-li se jen na něco zeptat, napiš to a stiskni „Komentovat“. Člen dostane
upozornění a na jeho odpověď zase schvalovatelé.

## Kdo smí rozhodovat

- Členové s oprávněním Schvalovatel a manažer skupiny.
- Ne správci organizace: skupiny spravují, ale o ničím volnu nerozhodují. Ke schvalování potřebují
  oprávnění Schvalovatel přímo ve skupině.
- Ne o záznamech zrcadlených z jiné skupiny. O těch se rozhoduje ve skupině, kde byly zadané.

O vlastní žádosti můžeš rozhodnout jen s oprávněním Schvalovatel v dané skupině. Jinak o ní rozhodne
jiný schvalovatel.

## Nároky při schvalování

Schválení zkontroluje nárok člena na daný typ a rok, a počítá přitom jen už schválené dny. Žádost,
se kterou by nárok překročil, schválit nejde; správce skupiny může nárok nejdřív navýšit. Viz
[Nároky](https://www.flexi-day.com/cs/help/allowances/).

articles.title: Potvrzení změn, které připraví Asistent
articles.summary: Jak fungují potvrzovací karty Asistenta, u tvých změn i u schvalování a zamítání žádostí, a co se stane, když kartu potvrdíš, odmítneš nebo napíšeš dál.
articles.body:
Požádej Asistenta, ať ti zadá volno, zruší některou z tvých žádostí nebo zaznamená příchod či
odchod, a on změnu připraví jako kartu v chatu. Schvalovatelé takhle můžou i schvalovat a zamítat
žádosti. Nic se nezmění, dokud kartu nepotvrdíš.

## Co karta ukazuje

Karta položí otázku, třeba „Odeslat tuto žádost?“, a vypíše údaje, které Flexi
Day spočítalo podle stejných pravidel jako aplikace: typ, termín, pracovní dny, tvůj zůstatek před a
